description: Free public live order book for one outcome of an event (the same outcome pm_data_price_history reads, or outcomeExternalMarketId). bid, ask, midpoint and level prices are 0-1 fractions, not 0-100 points. Each side is cut to its best `depth` levels as served, with the full level counts in bidLevels/askLevels. Polymarket and Kalshi only; orderBook: null is valid (venue not served, no resting orders, or a selected outcome book older than 10 s). This is fetch-time depth, not an executable quote: use pm_quote for that. No API key required.

outcomeExternalMarketId.description: Venue market id of another outcome on the event (from pm_data_event).

source.description: Venue slug, as in pm_data_events rows.

name: pm_data_orderbook
title: Prediction-market outcome order book
